headline: Kaushalya Infrastructure statutory auditor Bira Kishore Barik has passed away
summary: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation has announced the death of its statutory auditor, Bira Kishore Barik. The company made this disclosure in a regulatory filing. Indian retail investors should note that the sudden demise of a statutory auditor may lead to delays in financial reporting or audit processes. Companies are required to appoint a new auditor in compliance with regulatory norms following such vacancies.
whats_next: Appointment of a new statutory auditor by the company
